column1: # One note per line: id, points, text, then key=value fields, split by tabs. Format: https://teoyujie.org/api/notes.txt

column3: Size an air purifier by its CADR and your room
column5: why=A higher clean air delivery rate filters air faster. ENERGY STAR gives a sizing table based on an 8-foot ceiling.

column3: Avoid air cleaners that intentionally generate ozone
column5: why=The US EPA advises against using air cleaners that intentionally generate ozone in occupied spaces.

column3: Check what a water filter is certified to remove
column5: why=Filters remove different substances. The CDC says to check the specific product certification and choose for the substance of concern.

column3: Compare washing machines on the water-efficiency label
column5: why=PUB labels household washing machines with two, three or four ticks for water efficiency.

column3: Check an N95 respirator against the NIOSH equipment list
column5: why=NIOSH says approved respirators have a printed TC approval number and recommends checking its certified equipment list.

column3: Choose UV400 or 100% UV protection on sunglasses
column5: why=The US FDA says sunglasses with either label block more than 99% of UVA and UVB radiation.

column3: Check sunscreen water resistance for swimming or sweating
column5: why=The American Academy of Dermatology says water-resistance labels indicate either 40 or 80 minutes in water; reapply as directed.

column3: Choose a smoke alarm with a 10-year built-in battery
column5: why=SCDF recommends home fire alarms with a built-in battery lasting 10 years, and says smoke detection provides earlier warning than heat detection.

column3: Check a fire extinguisher for its certification serial label
column5: why=SCDF says buyers can look for a serial label issued by a recognised certification body, physical damage and an operative pressure gauge.

column3: Compare appliance purchase price plus lifetime electricity cost
column5: why=NEA recommends adding purchase price to estimated annual energy cost multiplied by the appliance lifespan.

column3: Size your air conditioner for the floor area
column5: why=NEA says an oversized or undersized air conditioner operates less efficiently and gives a floor-area rule of thumb.

column3: Be wary of cosmetics promising miraculous results
column5: why=HSA says claims of quick, miraculous results may be uncertain and online reviews may not be from genuine consumers.

column3: Check air purifier filter replacement costs before buying
column5: why=The US EPA recommends considering both replacement filters and the cost of running a portable air cleaner.

column3: Check a toy's age label and small-parts warnings
column5: why=Singapore’s Consumer Product Safety Office advises choosing age-appropriate toys and following the labels; older children’s toys should be kept from younger ones.

column3: Check that a toy's button-battery compartment is secure
column5: why=Singapore’s Consumer Product Safety Office warns that swallowed button batteries can cause serious internal injuries or death.

column3: Check disinfectant concentration and contact time
column5: why=NEA says pathogens differ in resistance and the effective concentration and contact time depend on the disinfectant and pathogen.

column3: Choose the manufacturer-recommended PMD or e-bike charger
column5: why=SCDF advises using a power adaptor bearing the Safety Mark and recommended by the device manufacturer.

column3: Compare similar foods using the per-100 g nutrition column
column5: why=HealthHub says nutrition panels show amounts per 100 g or 100 ml as well as per serving, allowing objective comparisons.

column3: Check the nutrition panel behind a reduced-fat claim
column5: why=HealthHub notes that reduced fat does not necessarily mean low fat; the panel shows actual nutrient amounts.

column3: Check the assumptions behind an appliance energy-cost label
column5: why=NEA’s air-conditioner annual cost example uses S$0.27 per kWh and eight hours of daily use; your usage and tariff may differ.

column3: Search for product recalls before buying an appliance
column5: why=Singapore’s Consumer Product Safety Office advises an online search for recalls or safety flags before buying.
